description: Makes the ChatGPT Windows app easier to use with NVDA. It announces activity, supports speech, Braille, and sounds, and adds chat navigation, voice controls, and better focus handling in both ChatGPT and Codex.
changelog: Adds an app-scoped NVDA+grave accent shortcut that opens and focuses ChatGPT's native mode selector in focus or browse mode. NVDA announces the current mode, and the user chooses ChatGPT or Codex with the Arrow keys and Enter. Prevents stale selector events from restoring monitoring after ChatGPT closes. Keeps one scheduled polling timer to reduce repeated main-thread conversation scans.
